case.summary: Transaction 3602445 ($1,053.79) on card C00750-K2 was alerted due to a legacy real-time risk score of 0.57. The bank's calibrated second-generation fraud model scored the transaction at an exculpatory 0.001 with a historical fraud rate of only 0.63%. The purchase occurred in-person in region 315, an established region for the cardholder with 199 prior transactions and a benign regional fraud lift of 0.24. Additionally, the specific holder identity has zero prior confirmed fraud history, no card testing was observed, and linked ring device D000605 showed zero activity during the investigation window. The transaction is determined to be legitimate cardholder activity, and the alert is cleared.
